motivation: At t=6 the uniform-grid front reaches the first physical cell. Increasing kappa alone did not cure this; the AF-regular source remains finite and preserves leading AF coefficients.
continuum: Unchanged AF-regular gauge at kappa=.001,tau=.02,outer=.8,transition=.24. The uniform width=.24 control was already run at N513.
grid: Uniform x in [0,1], physical r=sinh(s*x)/sinh(s), s=4 or 6 fixed under refinement. All geometric derivatives and elliptic quadrature are in physical r; this only changes collocation points.
dissipation: Mapped computational third-difference KO with division by J=dr/dx; negative semidefinite in the discrete dr measure. Same fixed epsilon=.5, vanishes with grid refinement.
boundary: Same analytic AF coefficient evolution and actual scri. Boundary penalties use dx*J(scri). No inner excision, filtering or constraint projection.
diagnostics: Physical radial RMS weights r^2*J; compare nested physical r grids. Stage rays locate intervals by binary search and use physical dr slopes.
timestep: dt=CFL*dx; guards use max |c|/J and relaxation dt/tau, plus dt*epsilon/(dx*min J)<=2 for KO. No assumption that CFL*dx alone is sufficient.
validation: Independent Python/compiled nonzero-flux rates, mapped ray RK oracle, mapped quadrature, analytic gradient, physical-measure KO energy identity, checkpoint restart, and bitwise uniform legacy-library check.
acceptance: All original convergence, constraints, scri, extension and independent-control requirements retained. A map improves resolution distribution but cannot by itself establish stability.
